units.source_text: 此时万无理由可以谢绝会面，只得在南面厢房内设一客座，请薰大将入内。

en.t: At this point there was no possible reason to refuse the meeting, so a guest seat was prepared in the southern side room and General Kaoru was invited in.

units.source_text: 浮舟不肯立刻出来与他相见，众侍女勉强扶她出来，把拉门关上，略微留一条隙缝。

en.t: Ukifune would not come out at once to meet him, so the maids reluctantly helped her out, closed the sliding door, and left only a narrow gap.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了不快，说道：“造这门的木匠真可恶！

en.t: General Kaoru was displeased when he saw this and said, "The carpenter who made this door is truly hateful!

units.source_text: 我从来不曾坐在这种门的外面呢。”

en.t: I have never in my life sat outside a door like this."

units.source_text: 不知怎么一来，他竟把门拉开，走进里面来了。

en.t: Somehow or other, he actually slid the door open and came inside.

units.source_text: 他并不提及希望她代替大女公子的话，只是说：“

en.t: He did not mention his hope that she might take the place of the elder young lady, but merely said, "

units.source_text: 前在宇治邂逅相遇，窥见芳容以来，相思相望直至今日。

en.t: Ever since I happened to meet you at Uji and caught a glimpse of your lovely face, I have longed for you until this very day.

units.source_text: 如此念念不忘，定有宿世深缘。”

en.t: For me to keep thinking of you like this and be unable to forget you, there must surely be a deep bond from a former life."

units.source_text: 浮舟容姿原来就妍丽动人，薰大将觉得不失所望，对她无限怜爱。

en.t: Ukifune had always been beautiful and captivating, and General Kaoru felt that she did not disappoint his hopes, loving her with boundless tenderness.
